proposals.name: 刀圭
proposals.meaning: 古代量取药物的小匙，也借指药物、医术或中医诊疗。

character_roles.刀: 表示形似小刀的量药工具；在固定词“刀圭”中不取武器义。
character_roles.圭: 与“刀”构成器具形状称名；此词整体借指药物或医术，不单解为玉礼器。

proposals.quality_basis: 这是有明确词义的中医药领域名称，可用于中医诊所、中药服务或传统药事品牌；行业适配由完整词义本身支撑，不需要假设跨行业通用。R47 曾因领域较窄而排除本词；按当前允许具体行业适配的标准，本次重审后仅保留为条件待复筛提案，不声称为新发现。词典收录和查重未命中本身都不证明品牌质量或市场可用性。

nearby_terms.relationship: R47 previously reviewed and excluded. It refers primarily to tailoring tools and has a separate archaic figurative sense; it is not a medical near-synonym.

nearby_terms.name: 刀匠、刀工
nearby_terms.relationship: Existing database candidates refer to craftspeople or cutting skill, unlike the medicine and dosage sense of “刀圭”.

proposals.risk_note: The term is classical and may not be readily understood by modern customers without context; it can sound like a tool or a generic traditional-medicine category rather than a distinctive clinic or product brand. It only fits a clearly related medical or pharmaceutical business. No real-world company, trademark, domain or market-name search was performed.

independent_challenge_review.reason: Independent review supports re-evaluating “刀圭” for a TCM, pharmaceutical or medical-service brand now that a specific reasonable industry fit is allowed. Its classical register, recognition and category-label risk remain material. This is reconsideration of the R47 exclusion, not a new discovery.

proposals.counting_reason: Re-review proposal only; not a newly discovered name and not finally quality-accepted. It does not count toward 500.

not_admitted.reason: “刀路” is primarily a CNC/CAM path or toolpath descriptor; “刀模” and “刀版” name die-cutting tools or plates; “刀补” is a machining compensation function; “刀尺” refers to tailoring tools or an archaic figurative term; “刀画” and “裁刀” are work/process or tool labels; “刀具” is a broad product category. These may be accurate field terms, but as standalone names they currently read more like a feature, process, equipment or category than a distinctive brand. A specific industry alone does not resolve that issue, so they are not proposed. All are uncounted.
